title: Sun Emits X9 0 Flare on October 3, 2024 (SVS14701 - SDO 10-03-24 1219UTC 131-171 RedOverlay 4k).jpg
author: NASA/SDO
description: NASA’s Solar Dynamics Observatory captured this image of an X9.0 solar flare – as seen in the bright flash in the center – on Oct. 03, 2024. The image shows a blend of 171 Angstrom, and 131 Angstrom light, subsets of extreme ultraviolet light. Credit: NASA/SDO
